reuse.why: Extends the existing isNonBusinessDay predicate, the single holiday check used by all weekend-rule functions, via a small isHoliday helper.

duplication.why: Holiday matching is defined once and nothing is copied.

placement.why: The new helper sits next to isNonBusinessDay in shared/schedules.

scope.why: Only the predicate and its tests change.

maintainability.why: A clear, named isHoliday function holds the YYYY-MM-DD / MM-DD rule in one place.
